posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
The last event went so well, I decided to start another one. I know a lot of people pushed themselves to play as much as possible, so this week's event will be a slightly different pace.

The Wraith, while vewry sneaky, has been spotted in numerous locations. Your job is to photograph the Wraith in those locations. SImply take a picture of Wraith's character card at those locations, and upload them here.

I will start with a few places today, and add more as the week continues. If you have a suggestion for a place, simply post it in this thread.

If somebody has a better place to post the pics, please say so.

After posting your pick, simply fill out your name and select the appropriate column:

So Sneaky

List of locations:

1) Train station

2) Park

3) Coffee shop

4) By a blue car

5) Next to a man with a hat.

 

Event ends on Sunday, November 10th 11:59 PM CST.
